project_type: Tauri/Electron app: React + TypeScript frontend, JSON-based persistence (localStorage + file backup)
language: TypeScript, Hebrew UI text, Hebrew documentation
build_system: npm workspaces, Vite for frontend, Tauri for desktop wrapper
verification_instructions: 1. Run `npm run test` after every backend change. 2. Run `npm run tauri dev` to test UI changes manually. 3. Check console for errors. 4. Verify data persistence after app restart.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None checked into git. Build output in dist/.
environment_constraints: Do not restart dev server on :9001 if already running (user may have it open). Never run destructive commands without confirmation.
contribution_requirements: Hebrew comments and error messages. No inline namespaces (imports at top). Minimal inline CSS (max 2 properties). Match existing patterns in similar files.
key_patterns: Services in src/services/database.ts export objects with async methods. UI components use Material-UI. State management with React hooks. Soft delete pattern: is_deleted flag + deleted_at timestamp.
directory_structure: src/services/ for business logic, src/pages/ for full-page components, src/components/ for reusable UI pieces, src/__tests__/ for vitest tests, docs/ for specifications
